goal: Ship a new developer tool with depth: an EditorConfig resolver verified against the official conformance suite and two shipping cores
notes: Explore idea: editorconfig-explainer (new venture). Engine passes 198/198 runnable EditorConfig core-tests (eval/core-tests.mjs on a clone of editorconfig-core-test); differential vs editorconfig-core-py 0.17.1 and npm editorconfig 4.0.1 over 23,149 random cases: npm agrees 23,100, core-py 22,005, every difference in four named causes (inline comments 637, escaped wildcards 452, negated bracket crossing / 55 for core-py; reversed range 49 for npm). Real-project sample of the 300 most-starred repos (89 with .editorconfig, 141 files): found Linux's [tools/{perf,power,rcu,testing/kunit}/**.py,] stray comma (section never matches in any core) and deno's '[*.out] # comment' header that core-py applies and the npm core stops parsing at. Local verification: run_workflow_locally --for-changes run three times; failures fixed are listed in errors; final targeted re-run noted in the PR. Graduation idea: GitHub Action around cli/check.mjs --strict; report core-py differences upstream (owner's account).

human_equivalent.basis: senior developer estimate: glob engine and parser from the spec (6h), core-tests harness and differential vs two cores (6h), CLI, page, guide and tests (8h), real-project sample and write-ups (4h)

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
